QuestInfo.name: POLLUTED! <1-Evil Eye>
QuestInfo.0: You heard there's a warning sign about monsters somewhere in the Northern Forest...
QuestInfo.2: I tried eliminating the #o2230100#s all-together, but the number didn't seem to decrease at all.

yes.0: Make sure to report the results to #r#p1061011##k after eliminating the monsters!

1.0: Ahh, concentrate! Phew... the art of levitation is such a delicate one that requires so much energy and effort, that one mishap can surely ruin it all. Please talk to me in whispers next time!
1.1: Anyway, what's going on? Anything urgent...? Hey! You found the polluted monsters. These monsters used to be just harmless animals, but with the dangerous force of polluted air, they have transformed into nasty monsters. Anything else strange around there? Anyway, I can't believe you managed to eliminate #b33 #o2230100#s#k. I can see 33 #o2230100#s hovering behind you. Don't you feel a little heavy on your back?

yes.0: I can tell you're noble enough to do this without expecting anything return, but this is just my way of saying thank you for helping us out. Please take it.
yes.1: You're not ending your travels right now, are you? There are many dangerous monsters outside the town. I have installed warning signs here and there, so go check them out. You will be given a generous reward! Beware of the monsters!

npc.0: Make sure to report the result to #rThe Rememberer#k after eliminating the monsters!

mob.0: Phew... I've been quietly meditating here, and you almost ended it. Please talk in whispers. Ah, so you're having a hard time understanding the notice I put up on the notice board. Please eliminate #b99 Evil Eyes#k, then come back here.
